cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Say the Scary Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before our skating qualifier, can you say the possibility we keep avoiding?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want you carrying that onto the ice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'm carrying it already. I just need you to say it first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We might not qualify. I'd still want to skate with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why did I need that second sentence so much? Could you name that fear too?

mechanism: A gives B permission to say the feared competitive outcome, then directs B to name the attachment fear exposed by reassurance.
confusable: D88 seeks B own attachment before A disclosure; D104 asks B to name A frightening possibility or feeling first.
comparison: A skating partnership risk differs from a family shop and inherited responsibility.
seedUse: Use D104-b failure plus I still want to skate with you; that added reassurance must cause the next fear request.
